name: Alila Fort Bishangarh
positioning: A restored hilltop warrior fort in Rajasthan, between Jaipur and Delhi, reimagined as a retreat that pairs Jaipur Gharana architecture with contemporary design
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside a restored Rajasthani fort
Couples looking at villa suites with a private plunge pool or hot tub
Families, with the Play Alila program for younger guests

facts.text: Alila Fort Bishangarh is a former warrior fort reimagined as a retreat, perched high above the Rajasthani landscape.
The fort is located between Jaipur and Delhi.
The restoration of the fort used traditional Rajasthani construction techniques with local stone, combined with contemporary architecture.
The restoration and conversion into a hotel took 10 years.
Rooms and suites combine traditional Jaipur Gharana architecture with contemporary design.
The suites have day beds and large bay windows.
The Presidential Suite is a top-floor suite with mountain and countryside views and a private terrace.
Arrival is at the Haveli, a modern house where the spa, pool, gym and kids club are located.
Play Alila offers younger guests storytelling, games and locally inspired arts and crafts.
Activities include morning safaris, midday helicopter adventures and sunset horseback riding.
Nazaara specializes in traditional Rajput hunter-style cooking over sandpits and open fire pits.
Amarsar, the all-day restaurant, is set in former royal living quarters.

highlights.text: The infinity pool has views of the surrounding mountains, greenery and Fort Bishangarh.
The Pool Villa is a villa suite with a temperature-controlled plunge pool.
A ride through a forgotten tributary of the Madhuveni ends with high tea by a ruined temple.
Spa Alila is set in a converted former cellar space.
The Kachchawa Deck and Lounge has been part of the fort from its origin and was used by noblemen to share state secrets.

considerations.text: Guests take a jeep up to the top of the hill to check in.
Jaipur International Airport is 71 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes limited nightlife and external dining options nearby.
